messages.subject: Energy & Mining Executive | ESG, Regulatory & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear KTC Search Team,

Your executive-search work across energy, renewables and mining aligns directly with my leadership background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where sustainable growth in energy and mining depends on regulatory credibility, stakeholder alignment and disciplined execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
